decisions.reason: The source establishes how the new MeetAlfred campaign and its Zap were created, but it does not change the requirement that HubSpot leads transfer into MeetAlfred.
Creating a MeetAlfred campaign and updating its Zap does not alter the campaign email account, its domain, or its intended use.
The source concerns MeetAlfred campaign and Zap creation, not provisioning or changing the campaign domain.
The MeetAlfred campaign workflow does not resolve or change the deferred and ambiguous direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization requirement.
